title: Boolean gate representation by a shape
statement: Let $D$ be a set, and let $g$ be a gate with input domain $D$ whose operation is either the identity, negation, or an AND operation of some arity. There is a gate shape built from a wire, a negated wire, or a conjunction of wires such that, for every assignment of values in $\\mathrm{Fin}\,2$ to $D$, evaluating $g$ gives the same value as evaluating that shape.
hypotheses_covered: $g$'s operation belongs to the specified standard Boolean gate set
